title: $S\mapsto\Spec LC(S,\Z)$ preserves finite limits
statement: The functor $u$ of [def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale] preserves finite limits.

proof.text: Use the canonical equivalence [def-weil-pbc-profinite-locally-constant-hom-equiv] between maps from the profinite space of connected components of Spec R to S and ring maps LC(S,Z) to R. Naturality in S follows after localization at every prime: both composites evaluate the same locally constant function at the same image point, and equality is detected in all prime localizations. Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivLeft constructs a left adjoint to the functor S to LC(S,Z) in the opposite category of commutative rings. The latter therefore preserves all limits. Compose with Scheme.Spec, which also preserves limits. The forgetful functor from schemes over the terminal scheme specZ is an equivalence, and the forgetful functor from the weakly-etale over category reflects finite limits. Reflect the obtained preservation through these two functors to prove finite-limit preservation of the concrete profiniteToProEt of [def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale]. No tensor-product or equalizer presentation is needed.
